description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-sync-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-bp12bh6z59nh8497f --source-db-cluster Type=sls RegionId=cn-hangzhou ClusterIds=rm-2zepqn129i9s3l2z3,rm-2zea4dj583129ksp6 OperateType=Create JobId=dts-xxxxxx --sync-platform ADB-CDC --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb ModifySyncJob --region cn-hangzhou --SyncPlatform 'ADB-CDC' --SourceDBCluster.1.ClusterIds 'rm-2zepqn129i9s3l2z3,rm-2zea4dj583129ksp6' --SourceDBCluster.1.Type sls --DBClusterId 'am-bp12bh6z59nh8497f' --SourceDBCluster.1.JobId 'dts-xxxxxx' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceDBCluster.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceDBCluster.1.OperateType Create
